item.title: City Manager Report
item.description: Most days in Belvedere, city government is what you don't notice. The parks are maintained for community use, building inspections help ensure safety, the streets are cleaned, and Council agendas address annual goals and issues as they arise. item.description: The City is addressing ongoing illegal dumping of used dog-waste bags within the public right-of-way along the 200–300 block of Belvedere Avenue.
